checks: source identity retains literal original name, declared format and exact byte length
chunked source fingerprint matches all original bytes across multiple chunks
source identity roundtrips without passwords, device state or local paths
format classification does not replace the checked file fingerprint
oversized input rejects before source hashing
invalid source limit rejects
maximum representable source ceiling does not overflow chunk arithmetic
empty input is not a selected backup source
source fingerprint never follows a symbolic link
source fingerprint rejects directory input
source fingerprint rejects a FIFO without blocking
same-length changed source bytes reject the original reviewed identity
source fingerprint observes cancellation before opening
source fingerprint stops between actual read chunks when its operation is cancelled
path replacement during an open descriptor read rejects even when original bytes were read
a cleanup request and UI-owner release cannot delete a worker-owned selected file
a new operation preserves another live workspace instead of globally clearing temporary sources
worker can still read exact source bytes after another owner requests cleanup
last workspace release removes only its own private directory
final release does not erase a replacement directory at the old workspace path
actual child process creates a private workspace and terminates before cleanup
terminated child's actual owned directory remains available for checked reclamation
new operation reclaims an actual terminated owner's marked workspace
abandoned-work scan never follows or removes a symbolic-link workspace
unknown legacy workspace is not treated as proven abandoned
scope: Actual Foundation descriptor/hash/cancellation and shared-workspace file lifetime. No actual UIKit service ownership, held native navigation, capacity, recovery receipt or device acceptance.
